a: Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: paam achat nichnasti achar rabbi yehoshua levet hakkisse, velamadti mimmennu shelosha devarim: lamadti sheen nifnin mizrach umaarav ella tzafon vedarom, velamadti sheen nifrain meummad ella meyushshav, velamadti sheen mekannechin beyamin ella bismol. amar lo ben azzay: ad kan heazta panecha berabbecha?! amar lo tora hi, velilmod ani tzarich.

Tanya, ben azzay omer: paam achat nichnasti achar rabbi akiva levet hakkisse, velamadti mimmennu shelosha devarim: lamadti sheen nifnin mizrach umaarav ella tzafon vedarom, velamadti sheen nifrain meummad ella meyushshav, velamadti sheen mekannechin beyamin ella bismol. amar lo rabbi yehuda: ad kan heazta panecha berabbecha?! amar lo: tora hi, velilmod ani tzarich.

Rav kahana al, gena tuteh pureyeh derav. shameh desach vesachak veasa tzerachav. amar leh: dame pummeh deabba kidla saref tavshila. amar leh: kahana, hacha at? puk, delav orach ara. amar leh: tora hi, velilmod ani tzarich.

Mippene ma en mekannechin beyamin ella bismol? amar rava: mippene shehattora nittena beyamin, shenneemar: "mimino esh dat lamo". rabba bar bar chana amar: mippene shehi kerova lappe. verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mippene shekkosher bah tefillin. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mippene shemmare bah taame tora.
Ketannae. rabbi eliezer omer: mippene sheochel bah. rabbi yehoshua omer: mippene shekkotev bah. rabbi akiva omer: mippene shemmare bah taame tora.
Amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: kol hatztzanua bevet hakkisse nitztzol mishshelosha devarim — min hannechashim, umin haakrabbim, umin hammazzikin. veyesh omrim af chalomotav meyushshavim alav.

Hahu bet hakkisse dahava bitverya, ki havo ayyli beh be tere — afillu bimama mittazzeki. rabbi amme verabbi assi havo ayyli beh chad vechad lechodeh — vela mittazzeki. amri lehu rabbanan: la mistefetu? amri lehu: anan kabbala gemirinan, kabbala devet hakkisse — tzeniuta ushetikuta. kabbala deyissure — shetikuta umive rachame.
Abbaye merabbeya leh immeh immera lemeal bahadeh levet hakkisse. ulerabbe leh gadya! sair besair michallaf.
Rava, mikkamme dahava resha, mekarkesha leh bat rav chisda amguza belakana. batar dimlach, avada leh kavvevta, umannecha leh yeda aresheh.

Amar ulla: achore haggader — nifne miyyad. uvabbika, kol zeman shemmitattesh veen chavero shomea. isi bar natan matne hachi: achore haggader, kol zeman shemmitattesh veen chavero shomea, uvabbika — kol zeman sheen chavero roehu.
Metivi: yotzin mippetach bet habbad, venifnin laachore haggader, vehen tehorin!
Bitharot hekellu.
Ta shema: kamma yarchiku veyihyu tehorin — kede sheyyehe roehu! shane ochle teharot, daakillu behu rabbanan.
Rav ashe amar: may "kol zeman sheen chavero roe" dekaamar isi bar natan — kol zeman sheen chavero roe et peruo, aval ledideh chaze leh.

Hahu safdana dinchet kammeh derav nachman, amar: "hay tzanua beorchotav hava". amar leh rav nachman: at ayaylt bahadeh levet hakkisse veyadat i tzanua i la? detanya: en korin "tzanua" ella lemi shetztzanua bevet hakkisse.
Verav nachman may nafka leh minneh? mishshum detanya: keshem shennifrain min hammetim kach nifrain min hassafdanin, umin haonin acharehen.
Tanu rabbanan: ezehu tzanua — ze hannifne ballayla bammakom shennifna bayyom.

Ini?! vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yanhig adam et atzmo shacharit vearvit, kede shello yehe tzarich lehitrachek! vetu, rava bimama hava azel ad mil, uvelelya amar leh leshammaeh: panno li ducheta birchova demata. vechen amar leh rabbi zera leshammaeh: chazi man deikka achore bet chevrayya, devaena lemifne! la tema bammakom, ella ema: kederech shennifna bayyom.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema bammakom, lo nitzrecha ella lekeren zavit.
Gufa. amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yanhig adam et atzmo shacharit vearvit, kede shello yehe tzarich lehitrachek.

Tanya name hachi, ben azzay omer: hashekem vatze, haarev vatze, kede shello titrachek. mashmesh vashev, veal teshev utemashmesh, shekkol hayyoshev umemashmesh — afillu osin keshafim beaspamya, bain alav.
Vei inneshi vitiv veachar kach mashmesh, may takkanteh? — ki kae, lema hachi: "la li la li, la tachim vela tachtim, la hane vela mehane, la charshe decharasha vela charshe decharashta".
b: Tanya, ben azzay omer: al kol mishkav shechav, chutz min hakkarka. al kol moshav shev, chutz min hakkora. amar shemuel: shena beammud hashshachar keistama lefarzela. yetzia beammud hashshachar keistama lefarzela.
Bar kappara hava mezabben mille bedinare: ad dechafnat — echol. ad detzachet — sheti, ad deratcha kidracha — shefoch. karna karya beromi, bar mezabben teene, teene daavuch zabben.
Amar lehu abbaye lerabbanan: ki ayylitu bishvile demachoza lemippak beh bechakla, la techezo la lehach gisa vela lehach gisa, dilma yatve neshe, velav orach ara leistakkole behu.

Rav safra al levet hakkisse. ata rabbi abba, nechar leh abbava. amar leh: leul mar. batar dinfak amar leh: ad hasheta la ayaylt leseir, ugemart lach mille deseir! lav hachi tenan: medura hayta sham uvet hakkisse shel kavod. veze haya kevodo: metzao naul — beyadua sheyyesh sham adam, metzao patuach — beyadua sheen sham adam. alma lav orach ara hu!
Vehu savar mesukkan hu. detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ammud hachozer mevi et haadam lide hidrokan. silon hachozer mevi et haadam lide yerakon.
Rabbi elazar al levet hakkisse. ata hahu romaa dachakeh. kam rabbi elazar unefak. ata derakona shamteh lecharkesheh. kare aleh rabbi elazar: "veetten adam tachtecha", al tikre "adam" ella "edom".
"Veamar laharagacha vattachas alecha".

"Veamar", "veamarti" mibbee leh! "vattachas", "vechasti" mibbee leh! amar rabbi elazar: amar lo david leshaul: min hattora ben hariga atta, shehare rodef atta, vehattora amra: ba lehorgecha — hashekem lehargo, ella tzeniut shehayta becha, hi chasa alecha.

Umay hi? — dichtiv: "vayyavo el gidrot hatztzon al hadderech vesham meara vayyavo shaul lehasech et raglav". tana: gader lifnim min gader, umeara lifnim mimmeara lehasech. amar rabbi elazar: melammed shessikkech atzmo kesukka.

"Vayyakam david vayyichrot et kenaf hammeil asher leshaul ballat", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol hamevazze et habbegadim, sof eno nehene mehem, shenneemar: "vehammelech david zaken ba bayyamim vaychassuhu babbegadim velo yicham lo".

"Im Adonai hesitcha vi yarach mincha", amar rabbi elazar: amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu ledavid: "mesit" karet li? hare ani machshilcha bedavar sheafillu tinokot shel bet rabban yodim oto. dichtiv: "ki tissa et rosh bene yisrael lifkudehem venatnu ish kofer nafsho vegomer". miyyad, "vayyaamod satan al yisrael", uchetiv: "vayyaset et david bahem lemor lech mene et yisrael". vechevan dimninhu la shekal minnayyhu kofer. dichtiv: "vayyitten Adonai dever beyisrael mehabboker vead et moed".
May "et moed"? amar shemuel sava chatneh derabbi chanina mishshemeh derabbi chanina: mishsheat shechitat hattamid ad sheat zerikato. rabbi yochanan amar: ad chatzot mammash.

"Vayyomer lammalach hammashchit baam rav". amar rabbi elazar: amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu lemalach: tol li rav shebbahem, sheyyesh bo lippara mehem kamma chovot. beotah shaa met avishay ben tzeruya, sheshshakul kerubbah shel sanhedrin.
"Uvehashchit raa Adonai vayyinnachem", may raa?
Amar rav: raa yaakov avinu, dichtiv: "vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam". ushemuel amar: efro shel yitzchak raa, shenneemar: "elohim yire lo hasse".
Rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: kesef kippurim raa, shenneemar: "velakachta et kesef hakkippurim meet bene yisrael vegomer". rabbi yochanan amar: bet hammikdash raa, dichtiv: "behar Adonai yerae".

Peligi bah rabbi yaakov bar idde verabbi shemuel bar nachmani. chad amar kesef hakkippurim raa, vechad amar bet hammikdash raa. umistabbera keman deamar bet hammikdash raa, shenneemar: "asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yerae".

Lo yikkanes adam lehar habbayit bemaklo vechulei. may "kappendarya"? amar rava: kappendarya kishmah. verav chana bar adda mishshemeh derav samma bereh derav mari amar: keman deamar inash: "addemakkefna addare, eul beha". amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hannichnas levet hakkeneset al menat shello laasoto kappendarya — muttar laasoto kappendarya.

Rabbi avahu amar: im haya shevil meikkaro — muttar. amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: hannichnas levet hakkeneset lehitpallel, muttar laasoto kappendarya. shenneemar: "uvevo am haaretz lifne Adonai bammoadim vegomer".
Urekika mikkal vachomer. amar rav bivi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol harokek behar habbayit bazzeman hazze, keillu rokek bevat eno, shenneemar: "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim".
Amar rava: rekika bevet hakkeneset — sharya, midde dehave amminal. ma minal behar habbayit asur, bevet hakkeneset muttar. af rekika, behar habbayit hu deasur, bevet hakkeneset shere.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava, veamri la ravina lerava, veamri la rav adda bar matna lerava: addeyalef mimminal, nelaf mikkappendarya!

Amar leh: tanna yalef mimminal, veat amrat mikkappendarya?! may hi? — detanya lo yikkanes adam lehar habbayit lo bemaklo shebbeyado, velo beminalo shebberaglo, velo bemaot hatztzerurim lo bisdino, uvefunedato mufeshelet laachorav, velo yaasenna kappendarya. urekika mikkal vachomer mimminal: uma minal, sheen bo derech bizzayon, amra tora: "shal nealecha meal raglecha". rekika, shehi derech bizzayon — lo kol shekken?!

Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: eno tzarich: hare hu omer: "ki en lavo el shaar hammelech bilvush sak". vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma sak, sheeno maus, lifne basar vadam — kach. rekika, shehi meusa, lifne melech malche hammelachim — lo kol shekken?!
Amar leh: ana hachi kaamena: nema hacha lechumera vehacha lechumera,

a: Veema: har habbayit deasur beminal — lelfe mimminal. aval bet hakkeneset dishre beminal, addeyalef mimminal ulehetter, nelaf mikkappendarya uleissur!
Ella amar rava: ki veto — ma beto, akkappendarya kafed inash, arkika uminal la kafed inash, af bet hakkeneset, kappendarya hu daasir, rekika uminal — shere.
Kol chotme berachot shebbammikdash vechulei.

Kol kach lamma — lefi sheen onin "amen" bammikdash. uminnayin sheen onin amen bammikdash? — shenneemar: "kumu barchu et Adonai elohechem min haolam ad haolam". veomer: "vivarchu et shem kevodecha umeromam al kol beracha utehilla".
Yachol kol habberachot kullan tehe lahen tehilla achat, talmud lomar: "umeromam al kol beracha utehilla", al kol beracha uveracha — ten lo tehilla.
Hitkinu sheyyehe adam shoel bishlom chavero vechulei. may "veomer"?
Vechi tema boaz middateh denafsheh kaamar — ta shema "Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil". vechi tema malach hu dekaamar leh legidon — ta shema "al tavuz ki zakna immecha".
Veomer: "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha". amar rava: hay kera, meresheh lesefeh midderish, missefeh leresheh midderish.
Meresheh lesefeh midderish — "et laasot laAdonai", may taam? — mishshum "heferu toratecha". missefeh leresheh midderish: "heferu toratecha" may tama? — mishshum "et laasot laAdonai".

Tanya, hillel hazzaken omer: bishat hammachnisin — pazzer. bishat hamefazzerim — kannes. veim raita dor shehattora chaviva alav — pazzer, shenneemar: "yesh mefazzer venosaf od". veim raita dor sheen hattora chaviva alav — kannes, shenneemar: "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha".
Darash bar kappara: zalat — kevotz kene minna, baatar delet gevar — tamman heve gevar. amar abbaye: shema minna, baatar deit gevar — tamman la tihve gevar.
Peshita! lo nitzrecha ella besheshshenehem shavin.
Darash bar kappara: ezohi parasha ketanna shekkol gufe tora teluyin bah — "bechol derachecha daehu vehu yeyashsher orchotecha". amar rava: afillu lidvar avera.
Darash bar kappara: leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla. ma hi? amar rav chisda: machta detalmiyyuta.
Tanya, rabbi omer: leolam al yarbe adam reim betoch beto, shenneemar: "ish reim lehitroea".
Tanya, rabbi omer: al yemanne adam appotroppos betoch beto, sheilmale lo minna potifar et yosef appotroppos betoch beto — lo ba leoto davar.
Tanya, rabbi omer: lamma nismecha parashat nazir lefarashat sota — lomar lach shekkol haroe sota bekilkulah yazzir atzmo min hayyayin.

Amar chizkiyya bereh derabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nismecha parashat sota lefarashat terumot umaasrot — lomar lach: kol sheyyesh lo terumot umaasrot veeno notnan lakkohen, sof nitzrach lakkohen al yede ishto, shenneemar: "veish et kodashav lo yihyu", usemich leh "ish ish ki tiste ishto", uchetiv "vehevi haish et ishto" vegomer. velo od ella sof shennitzrach lahen, shenneemar: "veish et kodashav lo yihyu".
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: veim netanan, sof mitashsher, shenneemar: "ish asher yitten lakkohen lo yihye", "lo yihye" — mamon harebe.
Amar rav huna bar berechya mishshum rabbi elazar hakkappar: kol hameshattef shem shamayim betzaaro — koflin lo parnasato. shenneemar: "vehaya shadday betzarecha vechesef toafot lach".
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: parnasato meofefet lo ketzippor, shenneemar: "vechesef toafot lach".

Amar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: kol hammarpe atzmo middivre tora, en bo koach laamod beyom tzara, shenneemar: "hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha". amar rav amme bar matna amar shemuel: vaafillu mitzva achat, shenneemar "hitrappita" — mikkol makom.
Amar rav safra: rabbi avahu hava mishtae: kesheyyarad chanina ben achi rabbi yehoshua laggola, haya meabber shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz.

Shiggeru acharav shene talmide chachamim, rabbi yose ben kippar, uven beno shel zecharya ben kevutal. kevan sheraa otam, amar lahem: lamma batem? amru lo: lilmod tora banu. hichriz alehem: anashim hallalu gedole haddor hem vaavotehem shimmeshu bevet hammikdash. keotah sheshshaninu: zecharya ben kevutal omer: harebe peamim kariti lefanav, besefer daniel.

Hitchil hu metamme vehem metaharim, hu oser vehem mattirim. hichriz alehem: anashim hallalu shel shav hem, shel tohu hem. amru lo: kevar banita vei atta yachol listor, kevar gadarta vei atta yachol lifrotz.
Amar lahem: mippene ma ani metamme veattem metaharim, ani oser veattem mattirim? amru lo: mippene sheatta meabber shanim vekovea chodashim bechutz laaretz.

Amar lahem: vahalo akiva ben yosef, haya meabber shanim vekovea chodashim bechutz laaretz! amru lo: hannach rabbi akiva, shello hinniach kemoto beeretz yisrael. amar lahem: af ani lo hinnachti kemoti beeretz yisrael. amru lo: gedayim shehinnachta naasu teyashim baale karnayim, vehem shiggerunu etzlecha, vechen amru lanu: lechu veimru lo bishmenu: im shomea — mutav, veim lav — yehe benidduy.
b: Veimru leachenu shebbaggola: im shomin — mutav, veim lav, yaalu lehar, achiyya yivne mizbeach, chananya yenaggen bechinnor, veyichperu kullam, veyomru en lahem chelek belohe yisrael.
Miyyad gau kol haam bivchiyya veamru: chas veshalom, yesh lanu chelek belohe yisrael.
Vechol kach lamma? mishshum shenneemar: "ki mitztziyyon tetze tora udevar Adonai mirushalayim".

Bishlama hu metaher, vehem metammein — lechumera. ella hu metamme vehem metaharin, hechi have? veha tanya: chacham shettimme — en chavero rashshay letaher, asar — en chavero rashshay lehattir! kasavri ki hechi dela niggarru batreh.
Tanu rabbanan keshennichnesu rabbotenu lakkerem beyavne, hayu sham rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili. patchu kullam bichvod achsanya vedarshu.

Patach rabbi yehuda rosh hamedabberim bechol makom bichvod tora, vedarash: "umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane". vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma aron Adonai shello haya meruchak ella shenem asar mil amra tora "vehaya kol mevakkesh Adonai yetze el ohel moed" — talmide chachamim sheholchim meir lair umimmedina limdina lilmod tora, al achat kamma vechamma.

"Vedibber Adonai el moshe panim el panim", amar rabbi yitzchak: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe, ani veatta nasbir panim bahalacha. ikka deamri kach amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: keshem sheani hisbarti lecha panim, kach atta haseber panim leyisrael, vehachazer haohel limkomo.

"Veshav el hammachane" vegomer, amar rabbi avahu: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: achshav yomru harav bechaas vetalmid bechaas, yisrael ma tehe alehem? im atta machazir haohel limkomo — mutav, veim lav — yehoshua bin nun talmidcha mesharet tachtecha.
Vehayeynu dichtiv: "veshav el hammachane". amar rava: af al pi chen, lo yatza haddavar levattala. shenneemar: "umesharto yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel".

Veod patach rabbi yehuda bichvod tora vedarash: "haseket ushema yisrael hayyom hazze nihyeta leam", vechi oto hayyom nittena tora leyisrael? vahalo oto yom sof arbaim shana haya! ella lelammedcha shechaviva tora al lomdeha bechol yom vayom kayyom shennittena mehar sinay.
Amar rabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyyay ish kefar akko: teda — shehare adam kore keriat shema shacharit vearvit, veerev echad eno kore — dome kemi shello kara keriat shema meolam.

"Haseket" — asu kittot kittot veisku battora. lefi sheen hattora niknet ella bachavura. kidrabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "cherev el habbaddim venoalu" — cherev al sonehem shel talmide chachamim sheyyoshvim bad bevad veoskim battora. velo od, ella shemmittappeshim, ketiv hacha "venoalu", uchetiv hatam "asher noalnu". velo od, ella shechotim, shenneemar "vaasher chatanu".
Ibbaet ema mehacha: "noalu sare tzoan".

Davar acher: "haseket ushema yisrael" — kattetu atzmechem al divre tora. kidamar resh lakish, deamar resh lakish: minnayin sheen divre tora mitkayyeymin ella bemi shemmemit atzmo aleha — shenneemar: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel".
Davar acher: "haseket ushema yisrael" — has, veachar kach kattet. kidrava, deamar rava: leolam yilmod adam tora, veachar kach yehege.
Amri deve rabbi yannay: may dichtiv "ki mitz chalav yotzi chema umitz af yotzi dam umitz appayim yotzi riv"?
Bemi atta motze chema shel tora — bemi shemmeki chalav sheyyanak mishde immo aleha.
"Umitz af yotzi dam" — kol talmid shekkoes alav rabbo paam rishona veshotek — zoche lehavechin ben dam tame ledam tahor.

"Umitz appayim yotzi riv" — kol talmid shekkoes alav rabbo paam rishona usheniyya veshotek — zoche lehavechin ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot. ditnan, rabbi yishmael omer: harotze sheyyitchakkem — yaasok bedine mamonot, sheen lach miktzoa battora yoter mehen, shehen kemayan novea.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: may dichtiv "im navalta vehitnasse veim zammota yad lefe" — kol hamenabbel atzmo al divre tora — sofo lehitnasse. veim zamam — yad lefe.

Patach rabbi nechemya bichvod achsanya vedarash: may dichtiv "vayyomer shaul el hakkeni lechu suru redu mittoch amaleki pen osifcha immo veatta asita chesed im kol bene yisrael"? vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma yitro shello kerav et moshe ella lichvod atzmo — kach, hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto, umaachilo umashkehu umehannehu minnechasav — al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach rabbi yose bichvod achsanya vedarash: "lo tetaev adomi ki achicha hu lo tetaev mitzri ki ger hayita veartzo", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma mitzriyyim shello kervu et yisrael ella letzorech atzman, shenneemar: "veim yadata veyesh bam anshe chayil vesamtam sare mikne al asher li" — kach, hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto umaachilo umashkehu umehannehu minnechasav — al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili bichvod achsanya vedarash: "vayvarech Adonai et oved edom haggitti baavur aron haelohim", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma aron shello achal veshata, ella kibbed veribbetz lefanav — kach, hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto, umaachilo umashkehu umehannehu minnechasav — al achat kamma vechamma.
May hi beracha shebbercho? amar rav yehuda bar zevida: zo chamot ushemone kalloteha sheyyaldu shishsha shishsha bechares echad.

a: Shenneemar: "peulletay hashshemini", uchetiv "ki vercho elohim". "kol elle mibbene oved edom hemma uvenehem vaachehem ish chayil bakkoach laavoda shishshim ushenayim leoved edom".
Amar rabbi avin hallevi: kol haddochek et hashshaa — shaa dochakto. vechol hannidche mippene hashshaa — shaa nidchet mippanav.

Midderabba verav yosef. derav yosef sinay verabba oker harim, itztericha lehu shata. shelachu lehatam: sinay veoker harim, eze mehem kodem? shelachu lehu: sinay kodem, shehakkol tzerichin lemare chittayya. af al pi chen lo kibbel alav rav yosef, deamri leh kaldae: malchat tarten shenin.
Melach rabba esrin vetarten shenin, melach rav yosef tarten shenin ufalga.
Kol hanach shene dimlach rabba, afillu ummana leveteh la kera.
Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: may dichtiv "yaancha Adonai beyom tzara yesaggevcha shem elohe yaakov", elohe yaakov velo elohe avraham veyitzchak? mikkan levaal hakkora sheyyikkanes beovyah shel kora.

Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: kol hannehene misseuda shettalmid chacham sharuy betochah, keillu nehene mizziv shechina, shenneemar: "vayyavo aharon vechol zikne yisrael leechol lechem im choten moshe lifne haelohim", vechi lifne elohim achlu? vahalo lifne moshe achlu!
Ella lomar lach kol hannehene misseuda shettalmid chacham sharuy betochah — keillu nehene mizziv shechina.

Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: hanniftar mechavero al yomar lo "lech beshalom", ella "lech leshalom", shehare yitro sheamar lo lemoshe "lech leshalom", ala vehitzliach. david sheamar lo leavshalom "lech beshalom", halach venitla.
Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: hanniftar min hammet al yomar lo "lech leshalom", ella "lech beshalom", shenneemar: "veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom".
Amar rabbi levi bar chiyyay: hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset venichnas levet hammidrash veosek battora — zoche umekabbel pene shechina, shenneemar "yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: talmide chachamim en lahem menucha lo baolam hazze velo baolam habba, shenneemar: "yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon".
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich".

Al tikre "banayich" ella "bonayich". "shalom rav leohave toratecha veen lamo michshol". "yehi shalom bechelech shalva bearmenotayich". "lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom bach. lemaan bet Adonai elohenu avaksha tov lach". "Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom".
Haderan alach haroe vaselaykaa la massechet berachot
Mishna yetziot hashshabbat, shetayim shehen arba bifnim, ushetayim shehen arba bachutz.
Ketzad?
Heani omed bachutz, uvaal habbayit bifnim: pashat heani et yado lifnim venatan letoch yado shel baal habbayit, o shennatal mittochah vehotzi — heani chayyayv uvaal habbayit patur.
Pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatan letoch yado shel ani, o shennatal mittochah vehichnis — baal habbayit chayyayv veheani patur.
Pashat heani et yado lifnim venatal baal habbayit mittochah, o shennatan letochah vehotzi — shenehem peturin.
Pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatal heani mittochah, o shennatan letochah vehichnis — shenehem peturin.
Gemara tenan hatam: shevuot, shetayim shehen arba.
b: Yediot hattumea, shetayim shehen arba.
Marot negaim, shenayim shehen arbaa.
Yetziot hashshabbat, shetayim shehen arba.
May shena hacha detane "shetayim shehen arba bifnim ushetayim shehen arba bachutz", umay shena hatam detane "shetayim shehen arba" vetu la?
Hacha deikkar shabbat hu, tane avot vetane toladot. hatam delav ikkar shabbat hu, avot tane, toladot la tane.
Avot may nihu? — yetziot, vitziot tere havyayn!
Vechi tema, mehen lechiyyuv umehen liftur, veha dumeya demarot negaim katane: ma hatam kullehu lechiyyuva, af hacha name kullehu lechiyyuva!
Ella amar rav pappa: hacha deikkar shabbat hu, tane chiyyuve ufeture. hatam delav ikkar shabbat hu, chiyyuve tane ufeture la tane.
Chiyyuve may nihu? — yetziot, yetziot tarte havyayn! — shetayim dehotzaa ushetayim dehachnasa.
Veha "yetziot" katane! amar rav ashe: tanna hachenasa name "hotzaa" kare la.
Mimmay? midditnan: hammotzi mershut lirshut — chayyayv. mi la askinan deka meayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, veka kare la "hotzaa"?
Vetama may? — kol akirat chefetz mimmekomo tanna "hotzaa" kare la.
Amar ravina: matnitin name dayka, dekatane "yetziot" veka mefaresh hachenasa lealtar. shema minna.
Rava amar, "reshuyot" katane: "reshuyot shabbat shetayim".
Amar leh rav matna leabbaye: ha tamne havyayn? tarte sere havyayn!
Velitamaych shitsere havyayn!
Amar leh — ha la kashya: bishlama

a: Bava deresha, patur umuttar la katane. ella bava desefa, defatur aval asur — kashya.
Mi ikka bechulle shabbat "patur umuttar"?! vehaamar shemuel: kol peture deshabbat patur aval asur, bar mehane telat defatur umuttar: tzedat tzevi, vetzedat nachash, umefis muresa!
Ki itzterich leh lishmuel, peture deka aved maase, peture dela ka aved maase ikka tuva.
Mikkol makom, tarte sere havyayn! peture deate behu lide chiyyuv chattat — ka chashev, dela ate behu lide chiyyuv chattat — la ka chashev.

Shenehen peturin, veha itavida melacha mibbenayyhu? tanya rabbi omer: "meam haaretz baasotah", haose et kullah, velo haose et miktzatah. yachid veasa otah — chayyayv, shenayim veasu otah — peturin. ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar gamda: nizreka mippi chavura veamru: "baasotah", yachid sheasaah — chayyayv, shenayim sheasauha — peturin.

Bea minneh rav merabbi: hitino chavero ochalin umashkin, vehotzian lachutz, mahu? akirat gufo kaakirat chefetz mimmekomo dame, umichayyayv, o dilma la? amar leh: chayyayv, veeno dome leyado. may tama? — gufo nayaych, yado la nayaych.
b: Amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerav: bar pachate! la amena lach, ki kae rabbi beha massechta la teshayyeyleh bemassechta achariti, dilma lav addateh. dei lav derabbi gavra rabba hu — kassefteh, dimshanne lach shinnuya delav shinnuya hu.
Hasheta mihat shappir meshanne lach. detanya: haya taun ochalin umashkin mibbeod yom, vehotzian lachutz mishshechashecha — chayyayv, lefi sheeno dome leyado.
Amar abbaye: peshita li yado shel adam enah lo kirshut harabbim velo kirshut hayyachid. kirshut harabbim la damya — miyyado deani. kirshut hayyachid la damya — miyyado devaal habbayit.
Bae abbaye: yado shel adam, mahu shettease kecharmelit? mi kansu rabbanan leahdore legabbeh, o la?

Ta shema: hayta yado melea perot vehotziah lachutz, tane chada asur lehachazirah, vetane iddach muttar lehachazirah. may lav beha kamippalgi? demar savar kecharmelit damya, umar savar lav kecharmelit damya?!
La, dechulle alma kecharmelit damya, vela kashya: kan, lematta measara. kan, lemala measara.
Veibbaet ema: idde veidde lematta measara velav kecharmelit damya, vela kashya: kan mibbeod yom, kan mishshechashecha. mibbeod yom — la kansu rabbanan, mishshechashecha — kansu rabbanan.
Adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! mibbeod yom, dei shade leh la ate lide chiyyuv chattat — liknesu rabbanan. mishshechashecha, dei shade leh ate behu lide chiyyuv chattat — la liknesu rabbanan.
Umiddela ka meshanninan hachi, tifshot derav bivi bar abbaye. devae rav bivi bar abbaye: hidbik pat battannur, hittiru lo lirdotah kodem sheyyavo lide chiyyuv chattat, o lo hittiru?
Tifshot delo hittiru. ha la kashya, vetifshot.
Veibbaet ema, leolam la tifshot, vela kashya: kan beshogeg, kan bemezid. beshogeg — la kansu rabbanan. bemezid kansu rabbanan.
Veibbaet ema, idde veidde beshogeg, vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid kamippalgi: mar savar kansu shogeg attu mezid. umar savar lo kansu shogeg attu mezid.
Veibbaet ema, leolam lo kansu, vela kashya: kan leotah chatzer,

a: Kan lechatzer acheret. kediva minneh rava merav nachman: hayta yado melea perot vehotziah lachutz, mahu lehachazirah leotah chatzer? amar leh: muttar. lechatzer acheret mahu? amar leh: asur.
Umay shena! lechi techul ala kora demilcha. hatam, la itavida machshavto. hacha, itavida machshavto.
Gufa. bae rav bivi bar abbaye: hidbik pat battannur hittiru lo lirdotah kodem sheyyavo lide chiyyuv chattat, o lo hittiru?
Amar leh rav acha bar abbaye leravina: hechi dame? illema beshogeg vela iddechar leh, leman hittiru?
Veella lav deihaddar veiddechar, mi michayyayv?! vehatnan: kol chayyayve chataot — enan chayyayvin ad shettehe techillatan shegaga vesofan shegaga.
Ella bemezid. "kodem sheyyavo lide issur sekila" mibbee leh!
Amar rav shela: leolam beshogeg, uleman hittiru — laacherim.
Matkif la rav sheshet: vechi omrim lo laadam "chata kede sheyyizke chavercha"?!

Ella amar rav ashe: leolam bemezid. veema: kodem sheyyavo lide issur sekila. rav acha bereh derava matne la behedya. amar rav bivi bar abbaye: hidbik pat battannur hittiru lo lirdotah kodem sheyyavo lide issur sekila.
Pashat heani et yado: ammay chayyayv? veha baenan akira vehannacha meal gabbe mekom arbaa al arbaa, velekka?
Amar rabba: ha manni? — rabbi akiva, deamar la baenan mekom arbaa al arbaa. ditnan: hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim baemtza, rabbi akiva mechayyev, vachachamim potrim.
Rabbi akiva savar amrinan "keluta kemi shehunnecha damya". verabbanan savri la amrinan "keluta kemi shehunnecha damya".
Lememra difshita leh lerabba devikluta kemi shehunnecha damya,
b: Uvetoch asara peligi? veha mibbaya bae la rabba! devae rabba: lematta measara peligi — uveha peligi: derabbi akiva savar keluta kemi shehunnecha damya, verabbanan savri la amrinan keluta kemi shehunnecha damya. aval lemala measara divre hakkol patur, udechulle alma la yalfinan zorek mimmoshit.

O dilma lemala measara peligi — uveha peligi: derabbi akiva savar yalfinan zorek mimmoshit, verabbanan savri la yalfinan zorek mimmoshit. aval lematta measara divre hakkol chayyayv. may tama, amrinan keluta kemi shehunnecha damya.
Ha la kashya: batar deibbaya hadar ippeshita leh desavar rabbi akiva keluta kemi shehunnecha damya.
Vedilma hannacha hu dela baaya, ha akira baaya!
Ella amar rav yosef: ha manni? — rabbi hi.
He rabbi? illema ha rabbi, detanya: zarak venach al gabbe ziz kol shehu — rabbi mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Hatam kidvaenan lememar lekamman kidabbaye, deamar abbaye: hacha bailan haomed birshut hayyachid venofo note lirshut harabbim, vezarak venach annofo.
Derabbi savar: amrinan "shedi nofo batar ikkaro". verabbanan savri: la amrinan "shedi nofo batar ikkaro".
Ella ha rabbi, detanya: zarak mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim ureshut hayyachid baemtza — rabbi mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel, mechayyev haya rabbi shetayim: achat mishshum hotzaa, veachat mishshum hachenasa. alma la bae akira vela hannacha al gabbe mekom arbaa al arbaa.
Ha ittemar ala, rav ushemuel deamri tarvavyyhu:

a: La mechayyev rabbi ella birshut hayyachid mekore, deamrinan: beta keman demalya damya. aval sheeno mekore — la.

Vechi tema hacha name bimkore — hatinach birshut hayyachid mekore, birshut harabbim mekore mi chayyayv? vehaamar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: hammaavir chefetz arba ammot birshut harabbim mekore, patur — lefi sheeno dome ledigle midbar.

Ella amar rabbi zera: ha manni? — acherim hi. detanya: acherim omrim: amad bimkomo vekibbel — chayyayv, akar mimmekomo vekibbel — patur. amad bimkomo vekibbel — chayyayv, ha baenan hannacha al gabbe mekom arbaa velekka! ella shema minna la baenan mekom arbaa.
Vedilma hannacha hu dela baenan, ha akira baenan. vehannacha name, dilma difshet kanfeh vekabbela — deikka name hannacha.
Amar rabbi abba: matnitin, kegon shekkibbel bitraskal vehinniach al gabbe teraskal, deikka name hannacha. veha "yado" katane? — teni "teraskal shebbeyado".
Hatinach teraskal birshut hayyachid, ella teraskal shebbirshut harabbim reshut hayyachid hu.
Lema dela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: naatz kane birshut harabbim uverosho teraskal, zarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv.
Dei kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatan letoch yado shel ani ammay chayyayv? mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ka mappek!
Afillu tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hatam lemala measara, hacha lematta measara.
Kashya leh lerabbi avahu: mi katane "teraskal shebbeyado", veha "yado" katane! ella amar rabbi avahu: kegon sheshshilshel yado lematta mishshelosha vekibbelah.
Veha "omed" katane? — beshoche. veibbaet ema — begumma. veibbaet ema — benannas.
Amar rava: ikkefal tanna leashmoinan kol hane?! ella amar rava: yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa. vechen ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa.

Amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay amar rabbi yochanan: zarak chefetz venach betoch yado shel chavero — chayyayv. may ka mashma lan? — yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa? veha amra rabbi yochanan chada zimna? mahu detema hane mille, hecha deachsheva hu lideh. aval hecha dela achsheva hu lideh — ema la. ka mashma lan.

Amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay amar rabbi yochanan: amad bimkomo vekibbel — chayyayv. akar mimmekomo vekibbel — patur. tanya name hachi, acherim omrim: amad bimkomo vekibbel — chayyayv. akar mimmekomo vekibbel — patur.
Bae rabbi yochanan: zarak chefetz veneekar hu mimmekomo vechazar vekibbelo — mahu?
May kamibbaya leh? amar rav adda bar ahava: "shene chochot beadam echad" ka mibbaya leh. shene chochot beadam echad keadam echad dame, vechayyayv, o dilma kishne vene adam dame, ufatur. teku.

Amar rabbi avin amar rabbi yochanan: hichnis yado letoch chatzar chavero vekibbel me geshamim vehotzi — chayyayv. matkif la rabbi zera: ma li hitino chavero, ma li hitino shamayim, ihu la aved akira?! la tema "kibbel" ella "kalat". veha baenan akira meal gabbe mekom arbaa, velekka!

Amar rabbi chiyyay bereh derav huna: kegon shekkalat meal gabbe hakkotel. al gabbe kotel name, veha la nach! — kidamar rava bechotel meshuppa, hacha name bechotel meshuppa. vehecha ittemar derava — aha ditnan:
b: Haya kore bassefer al haiskuppa venitgalgel hassefer miyyado — gollo etzlo. haya kore berosh haggag venitgalgel hassefer miyyado, ad shello higgia laasara tefachim — gollo etzlo. mishshehiggia laasara tefachim — hofcho al hakketav. vehavenan ba: ammay hofcho al hakketav? ha la nach!
Veamar rava: bechotel meshuppa. emor deamar rava besefer, daavid denayaych, mayim mi avidi denayychi?!
Ella amar rava: kegon shekkalat meal gabbe gumma. gumma peshita! mahu detema mayim al gabbe mayim lav hannacha hu, ka mashma lan.

Veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: mayim al gabbe mayim — hayeynu hannachatan. egoz al gabbe mayim — lav hayeynu hannachato. bae rava: egoz bichli ucheli tzaf al gabbe mayim, batar egoz azlinan — veha nayaych, o dilma batar keli azlinan — veha la nayaych, denayed. teku.

Shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin, machaloket rabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbanan. ditnan: shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin venaga tevul yom bashshemen — lo pasal ella shemen bilvad. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shenehem mechubbarim ze laze.
Amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay amar rabbi yochanan: haya taun ochlim umashkin, venichnas veyotze kol hayyom kullo — eno chayyayv ad sheyyaamod.
Amar abbaye: vehu sheamad lafush. mimmay — middeamar mar toch arba ammot amad lafush — patur, lechattef — chayyayv. chutz learba ammot, amad lafush — chayyayv. lechattef — patur.

May ka mashma lan? — shello hayta akira mishshaa rishona lechach? ha amra rabbi yochanan chada zimna! deamar rav safra amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hammaavir chafatzim mizzavit lezavit, venimlach alehen vehotzian — patur, shello hayta akira mishshaa rishona lechach. amorae ninhu, mar amar la behay lishshana, umar amar la behay lishshana.
Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi mechanut liflatya derech setav — chayyayv. uven azzay poter.
Bishlama ben azzay, kasavar mehallech keomed dame. ella rabbanan, nehi name dekasavri mehallech lav keomed dame, hecha ashkachna kehay gavvna dechayyayv?
Amar rav safra amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Midde dehave ammaavir chefetz birshut harabbim. hatam, lav af al gav dechamma denaket leh veazel patur, ki mannach leh — chayyayv. hacha name la shena.
Mi dame?! hatam kol hecha demannach leh mekom chiyyuv hu. hacha, i mannach leh bistav mekom petur hu.
Ella midde dehave ammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba. hatam lav af al gav dei mannach leh betoch arba ammot patur, ki mannach leh besof arba ammot chayyayv, hacha name la shena.
Mi dame?! hatam, legabbe dehay gavra mekom petur hu, lechulle alma mekom chiyyuv hu. hacha lechulle alma mekom petur hu.

Ella midde dehave ammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim derech tzidde reshut harabbim. hatam, lav af al gav dei mannach leh atztzidde reshut harabbim — patur, vechi mannach leh birshut harabbim — chayyayv, hacha name la shena.
Matkif la rav pappa: hanicha lerabbanan deamri tzidde reshut harabbim lav kirshut harabbim dame. ella lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar tzidde reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim dame, may ikka lememar?

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav ika: emor deshamat lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar tzidde reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim dame hecha delekka chippufe. aval hecha deikka chippufe mi shamat leh? hilkach leha damya.

Amar rabbi yochanan: umode ben azzay bezorek. tanya name hachi: hammotzi mechanut liflatya derech setav — chayyayv. echad hammotzi, veechad hammachnis, veechad hazzorek, veechad hammoshit. ben azzay omer: hammotzi vehammachnis patur, hammoshit vehazzorek — chayyayv.
Tanu rabbanan, arba reshuyot lashshabbat: reshut hayyachid, ureshut harabbim, vecharmelit, umekom petur.
Veezo hi reshut hayyachid? — charitz shehu amok asara verachav arbaa, vechen gader shehu gavoah asara verachav arbaa — zo hi reshut hayyachid gemura.

Veezo hi reshut harabbim? seratya ufelatya gedola, umevoot hamefullashin — zo hi reshut harabbim gemura. en motziin mershut hayyachid zo lirshut harabbim zo, veen machnisin mershut harabbim zo lirshut hayyachid zo, veim hotzi vehichnis beshogeg — chayyayv chattat, bemezid — anush karet, veniskal.

Aval yam uvika veistevonit vehakkarmelit — enah lo kirshut harabbim velo kirshut hayyachid. veen nosin venotnin betochah. veim nasa venatan betochah — patur. veen motziin mittochah lirshut harabbim, velo mershut harabbim letochah. veen machnisin mershut hayyachid letochah, velo mittochah lirshut hayyachid. veim hotzi vehichnis patur.
Chatzerot shel rabbim umevoot sheenan mefullashin, ervu — muttarin. lo ervu — asurim.

Adam omed al haiskuppa, notel mibbaal habbayit venoten lo, notel meani venoten lo, uvilvad shello yittol mibbaal habbayit venoten leani, meani venoten levaal habbayit. veim natal venatan — shelashtan peturim.
Acherim omrim: iskuppa meshammeshet shete reshuyot. bizman shehappetach patuach — kelifnim, petach naul — kelachutz. veim hayta iskuppa gevoha asara urechava arbaa — hare ze reshut leatzmah.
Amar mar: "zo hi reshut hayyachid". lemaote may? lemaote ha derabbi yehuda. detanya, yeter al ken amar rabbi yehuda: mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim, ose
b: Lechi mikkan, velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach!
Veammay karu leh "gemura"? mahu detema: ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda dela have reshut hayyachid, hane mille letaltel, aval lizrok modu leh — ka mashma lan.

Amar mar: "zo hi reshut harabbim". lemaote may? lemaote iddach derabbi yehuda. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: im hayta derech reshut harabbim mafsaktan — yesallekenna litzdadin. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich.
Veammay karu leh "gemura"? ayyeyde ditna resha "gemura", tena name sefa "gemura".

Velachashov name midbar, deha tanya: ezo hi reshut harabbim? — seratya ufelatya gedola, umevoot hamefullashin, vehammidbar! amar abbaye: la kashya, kan bizman sheyyisrael sheruyin bammidbar. kan bizman hazze.
Amar mar: im hotzi vehichnis beshogeg — chayyayv chattat, bemezid — anush karet, veniskal. beshogeg chayyayv chattat, peshita! bemezid anush karet veniskal itztericha leh.
Ha name peshita! ha ka mashma lan kidrav, deamar rav: matzati megillat setarim be rabbi chiyyay vechatuv bah: isi ben yehuda omer: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, veeno chayyayv ella achat.
Ini?! vehatnan: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat. vehavenan ba: minyana lema li? veamar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullan behelem achat — chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Ella ema: eno chayyayv al achat mehen. veha ka mashma lan: ha mehanach dela mesappekan.

Amar mar: aval yam uvika vehaistevonit vehakkarmelit enan lo kirshut hayyachid velo kirshut harabbim. uvika eno lo kirshut hayyachid velo kirshut harabbim? veha tenan habbika bimot hachamma, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattumea. bimot haggeshamim, reshut hayyachid lechan ulechan!
Amar ulla: leolam karmelit havya, veammay kare la reshut hayyachid — lefi sheenah reshut harabbim.
Rav ashe amar:

a: Kegon deit la mechitztzot. vechi ha deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira, vaafillu kor vaafillu korayim, hazzorek letocho chayyayv. may tama? — mechitza hi, ella shemchusseret dayorin.
Bishlama rav ashe la amar kidulla, ella ulla may tama la amar kishmateh? amar lach: i deit la mechitztzot "bika" kare la?! karpef hi! verav ashe "reshut hayyachid" katane.

Vehakkarmelit. attu kullehu name lav karmelit ninhu? ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lekeren zavit hassemucha lirshut harabbim. deaf al gav dezimnin dedachaki beh rabbim veayyli legavva, kevan dela nicha tashmishteh, ki charmelit dame.

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: ben haammudin niddon kecharmelit. may tama? af al gav dedarsi ba rabbim, kevan dela mistaggi lehu behedya — kecharmelit damya. amar rabbi zera amar rav yehuda: itzteva shellifne haammudim niddon kecharmelit.

Leman deamar ben haammudim, kol shekken itzteva. leman deamar itzteva — itzteva hu dela nicha tashmishteh, aval ben haammudim denicha tashmishteh — la. lishshana acharina: aval ben haammudin dezimnin dedarsi leh rabbim, kirshut harabbim damya.
Amar rabba bar shela amar rav chisda: levena zekufa birshut harabbim vezarak vetach befaneha — chayyayv. al gabbah — patur.

Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: vehu sheggevoha shelosha, dela darsi la rabbim. aval hizme vehige, af al gav dela gevihe shelosha. vechiyyay bar rav amar: afillu hizme vehige, aval tzoa la. verav ashe amar: afillu tzoa.

Amar rabba deve rav shela: ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: en karmelit pechuta mearbaa. veamar rav sheshet: vetofeset ad asara. may "vetofeset ad asara"? illema dei ikka mechitza asara hu dehave karmelit, vei la — la have karmelit, vela? vehaamar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rav: bayit sheen betocho asara vekeruyo mashlimo laasara, al gaggo — muttar letaltel bechullo, betocho — en mittaltelin bo ella arba ammot!

Ella may "vetofeset ad asara" — dead asara hu dehavya karmelit, lemala measara tefachim la havya karmelit. vechi ha daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, la teyhavve bemille deshabbeta lemala measara. lemay hilcheta? illema deen reshut hayyachid lemala measara? vehaamar rav chisda: naatz kane birshut hayyachid vezarak venach al gabbav, afillu gavoah mea amma — chayyayv, mippene shershut hayyachid ola ad larakia.
b: Ella deen reshut harabbim lemala measara — matnitin hi! ditnan: hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara tefachim — kezorek baavir. lematta measara tefachim — kezorek baaretz.

Ella karmelit, deen karmelit lemala measara. veakkilu ba rabbanan mikkulle reshut hayyachid umikkulle reshut harabbim. mikkulle reshut hayyachid — dei ikka makom arbaa hu dehavya karmelit, vei la — mekom patur bealma hu. mikkulle reshut harabbim — dead asara tefachim hu dehavya karmelit, lemala measara tefachim la havya karmelit.
Gufa, amar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rav: bayit sheen tocho asara vekeruyo mashlimo laasara, al gaggo — muttar letaltel bechullo, betocho — en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot.

Amar abbaye: veim chakak bo arbaa al arbaa vehishlimo laasara, — muttar letaltel bechullo. may tama? — have chore reshut hayyachid, vechore reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid damu. deittemar: chore reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid damu, chore reshut harabbim, abbaye omer kirshut harabbim damu. rava omer: lav kirshut harabbim damu.

Amar leh rava leabbaye: ledidach deamrat chore reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu, may shena meha dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lekeren zavit hassemucha lirshut harabbim, vetihve kechore reshut harabbim?! hatam la nicha tashmishteh, hacha nicha tashmishteh.
Tenan: hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara — kezorek baavir. lematta measara tefachim — kezorek baaretz. vehavenan ba: may kezorek baaretz? veha la nach!
Veamar rabbi yochanan, bidvela shemena shanu. vei salka datach chore reshut harabbim kirshut harabbim damu, lema li leokuma bidvela shemena? lokma bitzror vechefetz, udenach bechor!

Zimnin meshanne la, shane tzeror vechefetz demihadar veate. zimnin meshanne la, bechotel delet beh chor. mimmay? — middekatane resha: zarak lemala measara tefachim — kezorek baavir. vei salka datach bechotel deit beh chor, ammay kezorek baavir? ha nach bechor!

Vechi tema matnitin delet behu arbaa al arbaa, vehaamar rav yehuda amar rabbi chiyyay: zarak lemala measara tefachim vehalcha venacha bechor kol shehu — banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbanan. derabbi meir savar chokkin lehashelim. verabbanan savri en chokkin lehashelim. ella lav shema minna, bechotel delet beh chor. shema minna.

Gufa. amar rav chisda: naatz kane birshut hayyachid, vezarak venach al gabbav, afillu gavoah mea amma — chayyayv, mippene shershut hayyachid ola ad larakia. lema rav chisda deamar kerabbi? detanya: zarak venach al gabbe ziz kol shehu — rabbi mechayyev vachachamim potrim. alma la baenan makom arbaa al arbaa.

a: Amar abbaye: birshut hayyachid dechulle alma la peligi kidrav chisda, ella hacha — beilan haomed birshut hayyachid venofo note lirshut harabbim, vezarak venach annofo, derabbi savar amrinan "shedi nofo batar ikkaro". verabbanan savri la amrinan "shedi nofo batar ikkaro".
Amar abbaye: zarak kavvevret lirshut harabbim, gevoha asara veenah rechava shishsha — chayyayv. rechava shishsha — patur.
Rava amar: afillu enah rechava shishsha — patur. may tama? — i efshar likrumiyyot shel kane shello yaalu lemala measara.
Kefaah al piha, shiva umashshehu — chayyayv. shiva umechetza — patur.
Rav ashe amar: afillu shiva umechetza — chayyayv. may tama? — mechitztzot letochan asuyot.

Amar ulla: ammud tisha birshut harabbim verabbim mechattefin alav, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv. may tama? — pachot mishshelosha midras darsi leh rabbim. mishshelosha vead tisha — la midras darsi leh vela kattofe mechattefi. tisha vadday mechattefin illaveh.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: gumma may? amar leh: vechen begumma. rava amar: begumma la. may tama? — tashmish al yede haddechak la shemeh tashmish.

Etiveh rav adda bar matna lerava: hayta kuppato munnachat birshut harabbim gevoha asara urechava arbaa — en metaltelin lo mittochah lirshut harabbim velo mershut harabbim letochah. pachot mikken — metaltelin. vechen begumma. may lav assefa: la, aresha.
Etiveh:
b: Nitkavvevn lishbot birshut harabbim, vehinniach eruvo bevor lemala measara tefachim — eruvo eruv. lematta measara tefachim — en eruvo eruv.
Hechi dame? illema bevor deit beh asara, ulemala" — dedalliy veotveh, ulematta" detattiy veotveh, ma li lemala uma li lematta. hu bemakom echad, veeruvo bemakom acher hu.
Ella lav bevor delet beh asara, vekatane eruvo eruv. alma tashmish al yede haddechak shemeh tashmish.
Zimnin meshanne leh hu veeruvo becharmelit, veammay kare la "reshut harabbim" — lefi sheenah reshut hayyachid.
Vezimnin meshanne leh, hu birshut harabbim veeruvo becharmelit. verabbi hi, deamar kol davar shehu mishshum shevut, lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot.

Vela tema dachoye ka medachena lach, ella davka kaamena lach. ditnan: im haya rekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek letochah arba ammot — chayyayv. vechamma hu rekak mayim — pachot measara tefachim. urekak mayim shershut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek letocho arba ammot — chayyayv.

Bishlama "rekak" "rekak" tere zimne, chad beymot hachamma vechad bimot haggeshamim. utzericha, dei ashmeinan beymot hachamma, daavidi inashe lekarore nafshayhu, aval bimot haggeshamim — ema la. vei ashmeinan bimot haggeshamim, aggav demittenif mikkere venachet, aval bimot hachamma — la. tzericha.
Ella hilluch tere zimne lema li? ella lav shema minna hilluch al yede haddechak — shemeh hilluch, tashmish al yede haddechak — la shemeh tashmish. shema minna.
Amar rav yehuda: hay zirza dekane, rema vezakfeh rema vezakfeh — la michayyayv ad deakar leh.
Amar mar: adam omed al haiskuppa, notel mibbaal habbayit venoten lo, notel meani venoten lo. hay iskuppa may?
Illema iskuppat reshut harabbim — notel mibbaal habbayit? ha mappek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim!
Veella iskuppat reshut hayyachid — notel min heani? ha ka meayyel mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid!
Ella iskuppat karmelit — notel venoten lechattechilla, sof sof issura miha ita!

Ella iskuppa mekom patur bealma hu — kegon delet beh arbaa al arbaa. vechi ha dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa tefachim — muttar livne reshut hayyachid velivne reshut harabbim lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachalifu.

Amar mar, uvilvad shello yittol mibbaal habbayit venoten leani, meani venoten levaal habbayit. veim natal venatan — shelashtan peturin. lema tehve teyuveta derava. deamar rava: hammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim — af al pi sheheeviro

a: Derech alav, chayyayv! hatam la nach, hacha nach.
Acherim omrim: iskuppa meshammeshet shete reshuyot: bizman shehappetach patuach — kelifnim. petach naul — kelachutz.
Veaf al gav delet leh lechi?! vehaamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: toch happetach tzarich lechi acher lehattiro!
Vechi tema delet beh arbaa al arbaa — vehaamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: toch happetach, af al pi sheen bo arbaa al arbaa, tzarich lechi acher lehattiro!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hacha beiskuppat mavoy askinan, chetzyo mekore vechetzyo sheeno mekore, vekeruyo kelappe fenim. petach patuach, kelifnim. petach naul, kelachutz.

Rav ashe amar: leolam beiskuppat bayit askinan, uchegon shekkerah bishte korot sheen bazo arbaa veen bazo arbaa, veen ben zo lazo shelosha, vedelet baemtza. petach patuach, kelifnim. petach naul, kelachutz.

Veim hayta iskuppa gevoha asara urechava arbaa, hare zo reshut leatzmah. mesayyay leh lerav yitzchak bar avdimi. deamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi omer haya rabbi meir: kol makom sheatta motze shete reshuyot vehen reshut achat, kegon ammud birshut hayyachid gavoah asara verachav arbaa — asur lechattef alav. gezera mishshum tel birshut harabbim.
b: Mishna lo yeshev adam lifne hassappar samuch lammincha ad sheyyitpallel. lo yikkanes adam lammerchatz, velo labbureski, velo leechol, velo ladin, veim hitchilu — en mafsikin. mafsikin likrot keriat shema veen mafsikin litfilla.
Gemara he "samuch lammincha"? illema lemincha gedola — ammay la? haikka shehut bayyom tuva! ella samuch lemincha ketanna.

Im hitchilu en mafsikin. nema tehve teyuveta derabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kevan shehiggia zeman tefillat hammincha, asur leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat hammincha.

La: leolam samuch lemincha gedola — uvetisporet ben elasa. velo lammerchatz — lechulla milleta demerchatz. velo levureski — levureski gedola. velo leechol — bisuda gedola. velo ladin — bitchillat din.

Rav acha bar yaakov amar: leolam betisporet didan, lechattechilla ammay lo yeshev — gezera shemma yishshaver hazzug. velo lammerchatz — lehazzia bealma. lechattechilla ammay la — gezera shemma yitallefe. velo labbureski — leayyone bealma. lechattechilla ammay la — dilma chaze peseda bizvineh umitterid. velo leechol — bisuda ketanna. lechattechilla ammay la — dilma ate leimmeshoche. velo ladin — bigmar haddin. lechattechilla ammay la — dilma chaze tama vesatar dina.

Meematay hatechalat tisporet? amar rav avin: mishsheyyanniach maporet shel sapparin al birkav. umeematay hatechalat merchatz? amar rav avin: mishsheyyaare maporto hemennu. umeematay hatechalat bureski? — mishsheyyikshor ben ketefav. umeematay hatechalat achila? — rav amar: mishsheyyittol yadav. verabbi chanina amar: mishsheyyattir chagoro.
Vela peligi: ha lan, veha lehu.

Amar abbaye: hane chavrin bavlae, leman deamar tefillat arvit reshut, kevan dishra leh hemyayneh la matrechinan leh, uleman deamar chova matrechinan leh?! veha tefillat mincha dilchulle alma chova hi, utenan im hitchilu — en mafsikin. veamar rabbi chanina mishsheyyattir chagoro!

a: Hatam la shechicha shichrut, hacha shechicha shichrut. i name, bemincha — kevan dikvia la zimna mirtat vela ate lemifsha. arvit — kevan dechulle lelya zeman arvit, la mirtat veate lemifsha. matkif la rav sheshet: terichuta lemesar hemyayneh?! veod, leku hachi velitzalle! — mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael".

Rava bar rav huna rame puzemake umetzalle, amar: "hikkon likrat" vegomer. rava shade gelimeh ufachar yedeh umetzalle. amar: "keavda kammeh mareh". amar rav ashe: chazena leh lerav kahana ki ikka tzaara bealma, shade gelimeh ufachar yedeh umetzalle. amar: "keavda kamme mareh". ki ikka shelama lavesh umitkasse umitattef umetzalle. amar: "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael".

Rava chazyeh lerav hamenuna deka maarech bitzloteh. amar: mannichin chayye olam, veoskim bechayye shaa. vehu savar zeman tefilla lechud uzeman tora lechud. rabbi yirmeya hava yatev kammeh derabbi zera vahavo aski bishmata. nega letzalloye vahava ka mesarhev rabbi yirmeya. kare aleh rabbi zera: "mesir ozno mishshemoa tora gam tefillato toeva".

Meematay hatechalat din? — rabbi yirmeya verabbi yona. chad amar mishsheyyitattefu haddayyaynin. vechad amar mishsheyyiftechu baale dinim. vela peligi, ha, deaski veatu bedina. ha, dela aski veatu bedina.

Rav amme verav assi havo yatvi vegarsi bene ammude. vechol shata veshata havo tafchi aevra dedashsha veamri: i ikka deit leh dina, leul velete. rav chisda verabba bar rav huna havo yatvi bedina kulle yoma, hava ka chalesh libbayyhu. tena lehu rav chiyyay bar rav middifti: "vayyaamod haam al moshe min habboker ad haarev", vechi taale al datecha shemmoshe yoshev vedan kol hayyom kullo? torato matay naaset? ella lomar lach kol dayyayn sheddan din emet laamitto, afillu shaa achat, maale alav hakkatuv keillu naasa shuttaf lehakkadosh baruch hu bemaase vereshit. ketiv hacha: "vayyaamod haam al moshe min habboker ad haarev", uchetiv hatam: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad".

Ad matay yoshvin baddin? amar rav sheshet: ad zeman seuda. amar rav chama: may kera? — dichtiv: "i lach eretz shemmalkech naar vesarayich babboker yochelu. ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorim vesarayich baet yochelu bigvura velo vashsheti". bigvura shel tora, velo bishtiyyay shel yayin.
Tanu rabbanan: shaa rishona — maachal ludim. sheniyya — maachal listim. shelishit — maachal yorshin. reviit — maachal poalim. chamishit — maachal kol adam.

Ini?! vehaamar rav pappa reviit zeman seuda lechol adam! ella reviit maachal kol adam. chamishit — maachal poalim. shishshit — maachal talmide chachamim. mikkan veelach — kezorek even lachemet. amar abbaye: la amaran ella dela teem midde betzafra, aval teem midde betzafra — let lan ba.

Amar rav adda bar ahava: mitpallel adam tefillato bevet hammerchatz. metivi: hannichnas levet hammerchatz, makom shebbene adam omdin levushin — yesh sham mikra utefilla. veen tzarich lomar sheelat shalom. umanniach tefillin, veen tzarich lomar sheeno choletz.
Makom shebbene adam omdim arummim ulevushin — yesh sham sheelat shalom, veen sham mikra utefilla, veeno choletz tefillin, veeno manniach lechattechilla.
Makom shebbene adam omdin arummim — en sham sheelat shalom, veen tzarich lomar mikra utefilla, vecholetz tefillin, veen tzarich lomar sheeno mannichan!
Ki kaamar rav adda bar ahava bemerchatz sheen bo adam. veha amar rabbi yose bar chanina: merchatz sheamru af al pi sheen bo adam, bet hakkisse sheamru af al pi sheen bo tzoa!
Ella ki kaamar rav adda, bechadte. veha miva bea leh ravina: hizmino levet hakkisse mahu, yesh zimmun o en zimmun? vela ippeshita leh. lav hu haddin lemerchatz? la, dilma
b: Shane bet hakkisse dimis.
En sham sheelat shalom. mesayyay leh lerav hamenuna mishshemeh deulla deamar: asur leadam sheyyitten shalom lachavero bevet hammerchatz, mishshum shenneemar "vayyikra lo Adonai shalom".

Ella meatta "hemanuta" name asur lememar bevet hakkisse, dichtiv: "hael hanneeman". vechi tema hachi name, vehaamar rava bar machseya, amar rav chama bar gureya, amar rav: share lememar "hemanuta" bevet hakkisse! hatam shem gufeh la ikkeri hachi, dimtargeminan "elaha mehemna", hacha shem gufeh ikkeri "shalom" dichtiv "vayyikra lo Adonai shalom".

Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: hannoten mattana lachavero, tzarich lehodio. shenneemar: "ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem". tanya name hachi: "ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: mattana tova yesh li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah, vaani mevakkesh littenah leyisrael, lech vehodiam. mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hannoten pat letinok, tzarich lehodia leimmo. may aved leh? amar abbaye: shaef leh mishcha, umale leh kuchela. vehaiddana dechayyshinan lichshafim may? amar rav pappa: shaef leh meoto hammin.

Ini vehaamar rav chama (bar) [berabbi] chanina: hannoten mattana lachavero en tzarich lehodio, shenneemar: "umoshe lo yada ki karan or panav bedabbero itto"! — la kashya: ha bemilleta daavida leiggalloye, ha bemilleta dela avida leiggalloye. veha shabbat, daavida ligalloye? — mattan secharah la aved ligalloye.

Rav chisda hava naket bideh tarte mattenata detora, amar: kol man deate veamar li shematata chadta mishshemeh derav yahevna leh nihaleh. amar leh rava bar machseya, hachi amar rav: hannoten mattana lachavero tzarich lehodio. shenneemar: "ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem". yahava nihaleh. amar chavivin alach shematata derav kulle hay? amar leh: in. amar leh: hayeynu deamar rav: melata allaveshayyhu yakkira. amar leh: amar rav hachi?! batrayyta adifa li mikkammayyta, vei hava naketna achariti, yahevna lach.

Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: leolam al yeshanne adam beno ben habbanim, shebbishvil mishkal shene selaim melat shennatan yaakov leyosef yoter mishshear banav, nitkanneu bo echav venitgalgel haddavar veyardu avotenu lemitzrayim.

Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: leolam yechazzer adam veyeshev beir sheyyeshivatah kerova, shemmittoch sheyyeshivatah kerova avonoteha muatin. shenneemar: "hinne na hair hazzot kerova lanus shamma vehi mitzar". may "kerova"? ilema kerova demikkarva vezuta — veha ka chazu la! ella mittoch sheyyeshivatah kerova, avonoteha mutzearin. amar rabbi avin: may kera? — dichtiv: "immalta na shamma". "na" begimatriyya — chamshin vechad have, veshel sedom chamishshim ushetayim. veshalvatah

a: Esrim vashesh, dichtiv: "shetem esre shana avdu et kedorlaomer ushelosh esre shana maradu. uvearba esre shana vegomer"

Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: kol ir sheggaggoteha gevohin mibbet hakkeneset lesof chareva. shenneemar: "leromem et bet elohenu ulehaamid et chorvotav". vehane mille bevattim, aval bekishkushe vaavarvare let lan ba. amar rav ashe: ana avadi lemata machseya dela charava. veha charava! meoto avon lo charva.

Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: tachat yishmael velo tachat nochri. tachat nochri velo tachat chabbar. tachat chabbar velo tachat talmid chacham. tachat talmid chacham velo tachat yatom vealmana.
Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: kol choli, velo choli meayim. kol keev, velo keev lev. kol mechosh, velo mechosh rosh. kol raa, velo ishsha raa.

Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: im yihyu kol hayyamim deyo, vaagammim kulemosim, veshamayim yeriot, vechol bene adam lavlarin — en maspikim lichtov chalalah shel reshut. may keraa amar rav mesharsheya: "shamayim larum vaaretz laomek velev melachim en cheker".
Veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: yafa taanit lachalom keesh linoret. amar rav chisda: uvo bayyom. veamar rav yosef: afillu beshabbat.

Rav yehoshua bereh derav idde ikkela leve rav ashe. avdi leh igla tilta. amaru leh: litom mar midde. amar lehu: betaanit yatevna. amaru leh: vela savar leh mar leha derav yehuda? deamar rav yehuda: love adam taanito uforea! amar lehu: taanit chalom hu. veamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: yafa taanit lachalom keesh linoret. veamar rav chisda: uvo bayyom. veamar rav yosef: afillu beshabbat.

Veim hitchilu en mafsikin, mafsikin likriat shema. ha tena leh resha en mafsikin? sefa atan ledivre tora. detanya: chaverim shehayu oskin battora — mafsikin likriat shema, veen mafsikin litfilla. amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella kegon rabbi shimon ben yochay vachaverav shettoratan ummanutan. aval kegon anu, mafsikin likriat shema velitfilla.

Vehatanya: keshem sheen mafsikin litfilla, kach en mafsikin likriat shema! ki tane hahi — beibbur shana. deamar rav adda bar ahava, vechen tanu save dehagronya amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: keshehayinu oskin beibbur hashshana beyavne lo hayinu mafsikin lo likriat shema velo litfilla.

Mishna lo yetze hachayyayt bemachato samuch lachashecha, shemma yishkach veyetze. velo hallavlar bekulemoso. velo yefalle et kelav, velo yikra leor hanner. beemet amru, hachazzan roe hechan tinokot korin, aval hu lo yikra. kayyotze vo: lo yochal hazzav im hazzava, mippene hergel avera.
Gemara tenan hatam: lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid. aval im hichnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote — muttar.
b: Vechen baggat.
Ibbaya lehu: karmelit may? amar abbaye: hi hi. rava amar: hi gufah gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?
Amar abbaye: mena amena la — dekatane: "vechen baggat". may gat? i reshut hayyachid — tenena! i reshut harabbim — tenena. ella lav karmelit.

Rava amar: "vechen baggat", leinyan maaser. vechen amar rav sheshet: "vechen baggat" — leinyan maaser. ditnan: shotin al haggat, ben al hachammin, ben al hatztzonen, ufatur. divre rabbi meir. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok mechayyev. vachachamim omrim: al hachammin, chayyayv. al hatztzonen — patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar.
Tenan: lo yetze hachayyayt bemachato samuch lachashecha shemma yishkach veyetze. may lav ditchuva lo bevigdo? la, denaket leh bideh.

Ta shema: lo yetze hachayyayt bemachato hattechuva lo bevigdo. may lav beerev shabbat? la, ki tanya hahi beshabbat. vehatanya: lo yetze hachayyayt bemachato hattechuva bevigdo beerev shabbat im chashecha. ha manni? — rabbi yehuda hi, deamar umman derech ummanuto, chayyayv.

Detanya: lo yetze hachayyayt bemachato hattechuva lo bevigdo, velo naggar bekesam shebbeozno, velo sorek bimshicha shebbeozno velo gardi beira shebbeozno, velo tzabba bedugema shebbetzavvaro, velo shulechani bedinar shebbeozno. veim yatza — patur aval asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: umman derech ummanuto — chayyayv, ushear kol adam — patur.
Tane chada: lo yetze hazzav bechiso, veim yatza — patur aval asur. vetanya iddach: lo yetze, veim yatza — chayyayv chattat.
Amar rav yosef, la kashya: ha rabbi meir, ha rabbi yehuda.

Amar leh abbaye: emor deshamat leh lerabbi meir bemidde delav hayeynu orcheh, bemidde dehayynu orcheh mi shamat leh? dei la tema hachi, ella meatta hedyot shechakak kav bivkaat beshabbat lerabbi meir hachi name dela mechayyayv?
Ella amar rav hamenuna, la kashya: kan bezav baal shete reiyyot, kan bezav baal shalosh reiyyot.
May shena zav baal shete reiyyot dechayyayv, demibbee leh livdika, zav baal shalosh name mibbee leh lisfira? lo nitzrecha ella levo bayyom.

Veha mibbee leh kede shello yittannefu kelav! amar rabbi zera: hay tanna hu deamar kol atztzole tinnuf la ka chashev. ditnan: hakkofe keara al hakkotel, im bishvil shettudach hakkeara, hare ze bechi yuttan". im bishvil

a: Shello yilke hakkotel — eno bechi yuttan"! mi dame? hatam la ka bae lehu lehane mashkin kelal, hacha ka vae leh lehay kis lekabbole beh ziva.
Ha la damya ella lesefa: areva sheyyarad delef letochah, mayim hannittazin vehannitztzafin enan bechi yuttan", veshebbetochah hare ze bechi yuttan".
Ella abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu, la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, veha rabbi shimon.

Tane deve rabbi yishmael: yotze adam bitfillin beerev shabbat im chashecha. may tama? — kevan deamar rabba bar rav huna chayyayv adam lemashmesh battefillin kol shaa veshaa. kal vachomer mitztzitz: ma tzitz sheen bo ella azkara achat amra tora "vehaya al mitzcho tamid" — shello yassiach dato mimmennu, tefillin sheyyesh bahen azkarot harebe — al achat kamma vechamma. hilkach midkar dacher lehu. tanya, chananya omer: chayyayv adam lemashmesh bevigdo erev shabbat im chashecha. amar rav yosef: hilcheta rabbati leshabbat.

Lo yefalle et kelav kulei. ibbaya lehu: lo yefalle et kelav bayyom shemma yaharog, verabbi eliezer hi. detanya, amar rabbi eliezer: hahoreg kinna beshabbat — keillu horeg gamal. velo yikra leor hanner shemma yatte. o dilma tarvayyhu shemma yatte?!
Ta shema: en polin veen korin leor hanner. mi allima mimmatnitin?!
Ta shema: en polin leor hanner veen korin leor hanner, ellu min hahalachot sheamru baaliyyayt chananya ben chizkiyya ben garon. shema minna detarvayyhu shemma yatte, shema minna.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: afillu lehavechin ben bigdo levigde ishto. amar rava: la amaran ella divne machoza, aval divne chaklayata midda yadi. vedivne machoza name la amaran ella dizkenot, aval diladot midda yadi.

Tanu rabbanan: en polin birshut harabbim mippene hakkavod. kayyotze vo amar rav yehuda, veamri la rabbi nechemya: en osin appiktevizin birshut harabbim mippene hakkavod. tanu rabbanan: hamefalle et kelav, molel vezorek, uvilvad shello yaharog. abba shaul omer: notel vezorek, uvilvad shello yimlol. amar rav huna: halacha molel vezorek vezehu kevodo, vaafillu bachol. rabba mekatta lehu. verav sheshet mekatta lehu. rava shade lehu lelakana demayya. amar lehu rav nachman livnateh: kitlan veashmeinan li kala desanvoti.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en horgin et hammaacholet beshabbat, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel mattirin.

Vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel: en meshaddechin et hattinokot leares, velo et hattinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut, veen menachamin avelim, veen mevakkerin cholin beshabbat, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel mattirin.
Tanu rabbanan, hannichnas levakker et hachole omer: "shabbat hi millizok, urefua kerova lavo". verabbi meir omer: "yechola hi shetterachem".
b: Rabbi yehuda omer: "hammakom yerachem alecha veal chole yisrael". rabbi yose omer: "hammakom yerachem alecha betoch chole yisrael". shevna ish yerushalayim, bichnisato omer: "shalom", uvitziato omer: "shabbat hi millizok urefua kerova lavo, verachamav merubbin, veshivtu beshalom". keman azla ha deamar rabbi chanina: mi sheyyesh lo chole betoch beto tzarich sheyyearvennu betoch chole yisrael? keman — kerabbi yose.

Veamar rabbi chanina: bekoshi hittiru lenachem avelim ulevakker cholim beshabbat. amar rabba bar bar chana: ki hava azlinan batreh derabbi elazar leshayyole bitficha, zimnin amar: "hammakom yifkodcha leshalom". vezimnin amar leh: "rachamana yidkerinach lishlam". hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rav yehuda: leolam al yishal adam tzerachav bilshon arammi. veamar rabbi yochanan: kol hashshoel tzerachav bilshon arammi — en malache hashsharet nizkakin lo, sheen malache hashsharet makkirin bilshon arammi! shane chole dishchina immo.

Deamar rav anan amar rav: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu soed et hachole? — shenneemar: "Adonai yisadennu al eres devay". tanya name hachi: hannichnas levakker et hachole lo yeshev lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe kisse, ella mitattef veyoshev lefanav, mippene sheshshechina lemala mimmeraashotav shel chole, shenneemar: "Adonai yisadennu al eres devay". veamar rava amar ravin: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu zan et hachole? — shenneemar: "Adonai yisadennu al eres devay".

Velo yikra leor hanner. amar rabba: afillu gavoah shete komot, vaafillu shete mardaot, vaafillu asara battim ze al gav ze. chad hu dela likre, ha tere — shappir dame. vehatanya lo echad velo shenayim! amar rabbi elazar, la kashya: kan beinyan echad, kan bishne inyanim. amar rav huna: uvimdura, afillu asara bene adam asur.

Amar rava: im adam chashuv hu — muttar. metivi: lo yikra leor hanner, shemma yatte. amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha: ani ekra velo atte. paam achat kara uvikkesh lehattot. amar: kamma gedolim divre chachamim shehayu omrim lo yikra leor hanner. rabbi natan omer, kara vehitta vechatav al pinkaso: ani yishmael ben elisha, kariti vehitteti ner beshabbat, lichsheyyibbane bet hammikdash avi chattat shemena! amar rabbi abba: shane rabbi yishmael ben elisha, hoil umesim atzmo al divre tora kehedyot.

Tane chada: shammash bodek kosot ukearot leor hanner. vetanya iddach: lo yivdok! la kashya: kan beshammash kavua, kan beshammash sheeno kavua. vei baet ema: ha veha beshammash kavua, vela kashya: ha bidmishcha, veha bidnafta.

Ibbaya lehu: shammash sheeno kavua bidmishcha mahu? amar rav: halacha veen morin ken. verabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: halacha umorin ken. rabbi yirmeya bar abba ikkela leve rav assi. kam shammaeh ka badek linhora dishraga. amara leh devethu: umar la aved hachi? amar la: shivkeh, kerabbeh sevira leh.
Beemet amru hachazzan kulei. vehaamrat resha "roe". may lav, likrot?! la, lesadder rashe parashiyyotav. vechen amar rabba bar shemuel: aval mesadder hu rashe parashiyyotav, vechulla parasha la.

a: Metivi: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hattinokot shel bet rabban hayu mesadderin parashiyyot vekorin leor hanner. i baet ema — rashe parashiyyotav, vei baet ema — shane tinokot, hoil veemat rabban alehen la ate leatzloye.

Kayyotze vo lo yochal hazzav. tanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: bo uree ad hechan partza tohora beyisrael, shello shaninu "lo yochal hattahor im hattemea", ella lo yochal hazzav im hazzava mippene hergel avera. kayyotze vo: lo yochal zav parush im zav am haaretz, shemma yargilennu etzlo.

Vechi margilo etzlo may have? ella ema: shemma yaachilennu devarim temein. attu zav parush lav devarim temein achel? amar abbaye: gezera shemma yaachilennu devarim sheenan metukkanin. verava amar: rov amme haaretz measserin hen, ella shemma yehe ragil etzlo veyaachilennu devarim temein bime tohorato.

Ibbaya lehu: nidda mahu shettishan im baalah hi bevigdah vehu bevigdo? amar rav yosef, ta shema: haof ole im haggevina al hashshulchan veeno neechol, divre bet shammay. bet hillel omrim: lo ole velo neechol. shane hatam delekka deot.

Hachi name mistabbera dehecha deikka deot shane. dekatane sefa: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenayim ochlin al shulchan echad, ze ochel basar veze ochel gevina, veen choshshin. velav ittemar ala amar rav chanin bar amme amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheen makkirin ze et ze, aval makkirin ze et ze — asurim. vehane name, makkirin ze et ze ninhu. hachi hasheta?! hatam deot ikka, shinnuy lekka. hacha ikka deot veikka shinnuy.

Ikka deamri: ta shema, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shene achsenayim ochlin al shulchan echad, ze basar veze gevina. veittemar ala, amar rav chanin bar amme amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheen makkirin ze et ze, aval makkirin ze et ze — asur. vehane name, makkirin ze et ze ninhu! hatam, deot ikka shinnuy lekka. hacha, ikka deot veikka shinnuy.
Ta shema: lo yochal hazzav im hazzava mishshum hergel avera. hacha name, deot ikka shinnuy lekka.

Ta shema: "el heharim lo achol veenav lo nasa el gillule bet yisrael veet eshet reehu lo timme veel ishsha nidda lo yikrav". makkish ishsha nidda leeshet reehu: ma eshet reehu hu bevigdo vehi bevigdah — asur, af ishto nidda hu bevigdo vehi bevigdah — asur. shema minna.
Ufeliga derabbi pedat: deamar rabbi pedat lo asra tora ella kureva shel gilluy arayot bilvad, shenneemar: "ish ish el kol sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva".

Ulla ki have ate mibbe rav hava menashshek lehu leachvoteh abbe chadayyhu, veamri la abbe yedayyhu. ufeliga dideh addideh, deamar ulla: afillu shum kureva asur, mishshum "lach lach amri nezira sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".

Tane deve eliyyahu: maase betalmid echad sheshshana harebe, vekara harebe, veshimmesh talmide chachamim harebe, umet bachatzi yamav. vehayta ishto notelet tefillav umechazzartam bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot, veamra lahem: katuv battora "ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha", baali sheshshana harebe vekara harebe
b: Veshimmesh talmide chachamim harebe, mippene ma met bachatzi yamav? velo haya adam machzirah davar. paam achat nitarachti etzlah vehayta mesicha kol oto meora. veamarti lah: bitti, bime niddutech ma hu etzlech? amra li: chas veshalom, afillu beetzba ketanna lo naga [bi]. bime libbunicha mahu etzlech? achal immi veshata immi veyashan immi bekeruv basar, velo alta dato al davar acher. veamarti lah: baruch hammakom sheharago, shello nasa panim lattora. shehare amra tora: "veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav". ki ata rav dimi, amar: mitta chada havay. bemareva amri: amar rav yitzchak bar yosef, sinar mafsik beno levenah.
Mishna veellu min hahalachot sheamru baaliyyayt chananya ben chizkiyya ben garon. shealu levakkero, nimnu, verabbu bet shammay al bet hillel. ushemona asar devarim gazru bo bayyom.

Gemara amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: "ellu" tenan, o "veellu" tenan? "veellu" tenan, hane daamaran. o "ellu" tenan, devaenan lememar kamman? ta shema: en polin leor hanner veen korin leor hanner, veellu min hahalachot sheamru baaliyyayt chananya ben chizkiyya ben garon. shema minna: "veellu" tenan, shema minna.
Tanu rabbanan: mi katav megillat taanit? — amru, chananya ben chizkiyya vesiato shehayu mechabbevin et hatztzarot.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: af anu mechabbevin et hatztzarot, aval ma naase sheim banu lichtov en anu maspikin.
Davar acher: en shote nifga.

Davar acher: en besar hammet margish baizmel. ini?! vehaamar rav yitzchak: kasha rimma lammet kemachat babbasar hachay, shenneemar: "ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval"! ema: en basar hammet shebbachay margish baizmel.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: beram zachur oto haish lattov vachananya ben chizkiyya shemo, sheilmale hu nignaz sefer yechezkel, shehayu devarav sotrin divre tora. me asa? — heelu lo shelosh meot garve shemen, veyashav baaliyyay uderashan.

Ushemona asar davar gazru. may ninhu shemona asar davar? ditnan, ellu poslin et hatteruma: haochel ochel rishon, vehaochel ochel sheni, vehashshote mashkin temein, vehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin, vetahor shennaflu al rosho verubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, vehassefer, vehayyadayim, vehattevul yom, vehaochalim vehakkelim shennitmeu bemashkin.
Man tena haochel ochel rishon vehaochel ochel sheni — mifsal pasli, tammoye

a: La metammu? amar rabba bar bar chana, rabbi yehoshua hi. ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer: haochel ochel rishon — rishon. veochel ochel sheni — sheni. ochel shelishi — shelishi. rabbi yehoshua omer: haochel ochel rishon veochel sheni — sheni. shelishi — sheni lakkodesh, veen sheni latteruma bechullin shennaasu al tohorat teruma.
Ochel ochel rishon veochel ochel sheni — may tama gezaru beh rabbanan tumea? dezimnin deachel ochalin temein, veshakel mashkin ditruma, veshade lefummeh ufasel lehu.

Shote mashkin temein — may tama gezaru beh rabbanan tumea? dezimnin deshate mashkin temein, veshakel ochalin ditruma veshade lefummeh ufasel lehu. hayeynu hach? mahu detema: ha shechichi, veha la shechichi — ka mashma lan.

Vehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin — may tama gezaru beh rabbanan tumea? amar rav bivi amar rav assi: shebbattechilla hayu tovlin beme mearot mechunnasin useruchin, vehayu notnin alehen mayim sheuvin. hitchilu vaasaum keva — gazru alehem tumea.

May keva? — amar abbaye, shehayu omrim: lo ellu metaharin, ella ellu vaellu metaharin. amar leh rava: may nafka minna, ha ka tavli behanach? ella amar rava: shehayu omrim: lo ellu metaharin, ella ellu metaharin.
Vetahor shennaflu al rosho verubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin — may tama gezaru beh rabbanan tumea? — dei la ha, la kayyma ha.

Vesefer — may tama gezaru beh rabbanan tumea? — amar rav mesharsheya: shebbitchilla hayu matzniin (et) ochalin ditruma etzel sefer tora, vaamaru: hay kodesh vehay kodesh. kevan dekachazu dekaatu lide feseda, gezaru beh rabbanan tumea.

Vehayyadayim — mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot hen. tana, af yadayim habbaot mechamat sefer poslot et hatteruma. mishshum derabbi parnach — deamar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: haochez sefer tora arom, nikbar arom. arom salka datach? ella amar rabbi zera: arom belo mitzvot. belo mitzvot salka datach? ella ema: arom belo otah mitzva.
He gezur beresha? ilema ha gezur beresha,
b: Kevan dehach gezur beresha, ha tu lema li? ella hach gezur beresha, vahadar gezur bechullehu yadayim.
Utevul yom — tevul yom deorayyta hu, dichtiv: "uva hashshemesh vetaher"! semi mikkan tevul yom.

Vehaochalin shennitmeu bemashkin — bemashkin demay? ilema bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz — deorayyta ninhu, dichtiv: "vechol mashke asher yishshate". ella bemashkin habbain mechamat yadayim, ugezera mishshum mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz.

Vehakkelim shennitmeu bemashkin — kelim deittammeu bemashkin demay? ilema bemashkin dezav — deorayyta ninhu! dichtiv: "vechi yarok hazzav battahor" — ma shebbeyad tahor timmeti lach. ella bemashkin habbain mechamat sheretz, ugezera mishshum mashkin dezav.

Veyadayim talmide shammay vehillel gezur? shammay vehillel gezur! detanya: yose ben yoezer ish tzereda veyose ben yochanan ish yerushalayim gezaru tumea al eretz haammim veal kele zechuchit. shimon ben shatach tikken ketubba laishsha, vegazar tumea al kele mattachot. shammay vehillel gazru tumea al hayyadayim!

Vechi tema shammay vesiato vehillel vesiato, vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shemona asar davar gazru, uvishmona asar nechleku. veillu hillel veshammay lo nechleku ella bishlosha mekomot, deamar rav huna: bishlosha mekomot nechleku vetu la. vechi tema: ato inhu gezur litlot, vaato talmidayyhu ugezaru lisrof. vehaamar ilfa: yadayim techillat gezeratan lisrefa! ella ato inhu gezur vela kabbilu minnayyhu, vaato talmidayyhu gezaru vekabbilu minnayyhu.

Veakkatti, shelomo gezar! deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beshaa shettikken shelomo eruvin unetilat yadayim, yatzta bat kol veamra: "beni im chacham libbecha yismach libbi gam ani", "chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar"! — ata

a: Shelomo gezar lekodashim, vaato inhu ugezur af litruma.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shemona asar gazru uvishmona asar nechleku. vehatanya hushevu! bo bayyom nechleku, ulemachar hushevu.

Gufa, amar rav huna: bishlosha mekomot nechleku shammay vehillel. shammay omer: mikkav challa. vehillel omer: mikkabbayim. vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze, ella kav umechetza chayyayv bachalla. mishshehigdilu hammiddot, amru chameshet revaim kemach chayyayvin bachalla. rabbi yose omer: chamishsha peturin, chamishsha veod chayyayvin.

Veiddach, hillel omer: melo hin mayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve — shechayyayv adam lomar bilshon rabbo. shammay omer: tisha kabbin. vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze. ad shebbau shene gardiyyim mishshaar haashpa shebbirushalayim veheidu mishshum shemaya veavtalyon sheshshelosha luggin mayim sheuvin poslim et hammikve, vekiyyeymu chachamim et divrehem.

Veiddach, shammay omer: kol hannashim dayyayn sheatan. vehillel omer: mippekida lifkida, vaafillu leyamim harebe. vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze velo kedivre ze, ella: meet leet memaet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaet al yad meet leet.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka hillel omer lismoch, veshammay omer shello lismoch. ki kaamar rav huna, hecha delekka pelugeta derabbevota bahadayyhu.
Vehaikka habbotzer laggat — shammay omer: hucheshar, vehillel omer: lo hucheshar. bar minneh dehahi, dehatam ka shatek leh hillel leshammay.

Yose ben yoezer ish tzereda veyose ben yochanan ish yerushalayim gazru tumea al eretz haammim veal kele zechuchit. veha rabbanan dishmonim shana gezur! deamar rav kahana: keshechala rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, shalchu lo: rabbi, emor lanu shenayim ushelosha devarim sheamarta lanu mishshum avicha.
