Shalach lahem, kach amar abba: mea ushemonim shana ad shello charav habbayit, pashta malchut harshaa al yisrael. shemonim shana ad shello charav habbayit gazru tumea al eretz haammim veal kele zechuchit. arbaim shana ad shello charav habbayit galta lah sanhedrin veyashva lah bachanuyot. lemay hilcheta? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: lomar shello danu dine kenasot. dine kenasot salka datach? ella ema: shello danu dine nefashot!

Vechi tema bishmonim shana name inhu havo, vehatanya: hillel veshimon, gamliel veshimon, nahagu nesiutan lifne habbayit mea shana. veillu yose ben yoezer ish tzereda veyose ben yochanan havo kadmi tuva!
b: Ella: ato inhu gezur aggushsha lisrof veaavira velo chelum, vaato rabbanan dishmonim shana gezur aavira litlot.
Lememra dachada gezerta hava lisrefa? vehaamar ilfa: yadayim techillat gezeratan lisrefa! yadayim hu ditchillat gezeratan lisrefa, ha midde acharina — la.
Ella: ato inhu gezur aggushsha litlot veaavira velo chelum, vaato rabbanan dishmonim shana gezur aggushsha lisrof veaavira litlot.

Veakkatti, beusha gezur! ditnan: al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma: al sefek bet happeras, veal sefek afar habba meeretz haammim, veal sefek bigde am haaretz, veal sefek kelim hannimtzain, veal sefek harukkin, veal sefek me ragle adam shekkeneged me ragle behema — al vadday maggaan veal sefek tumeatan sorfin et hatteruma.
Rabbi yose omer: af al sefek maggaan birshut hayyachid — sorfin. vachachamim omrim: birshut hayyachid tolin, birshut harabbim — tehorin.

Veamar ulla: ellu shishsha sefekot beusha hitkinu! ella ato inhu gezur aggushsha litlot veaavira velo chelum, vaato rabbanan dishmonim shana gezur idde veidde litlot, vaato beusha gezur aggushsha lisrof, veaavira — kidkae kae.

Kele zechuchit — may tama gezur behu rabbanan tumea? amar rabbi yochanan amar resh lakish: hoil utechillat beriyyaytan min hachol shavvinhu rabbanan kichle cheres. ella, meatta lo tehe lahen tohora bemikve. allema tenan: veellu chotztzin bechelim — hazzefet vehammor bichle zechuchit!

Hacha vemay askinan? — kegon shennikkevu vehittif letochan avar. verabbi meir hi, deamar hakkol holech achar hammaamid. detanya: kele zechuchit shennikkevu vehittif letochan avar, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: rabbi meir metamme vachachamim metaharin.
Ella meatta

a: La littammu miggabban. allema tenan: kele cheres uchele neter tumeatan shava: mittammein umetammein meavirehen, umittammein meachorehen veen mittammein miggabbehen, usheviratan metahartan. kele neter uchele cheres hu detumeatan shava aval midde acharina — la! amri, kevan dechi nishtabberu yesh lahem takkana, shavvinhu kichle mattachot.

Ella meatta, yachzeru letumeatan yeshana kichle mattachot? ditnan: kele mattachot, peshutehen umekabbelehen temein. nishberu — taharu. chazar veasa mehen kelim — chazru letumeatan yeshana. veillu gabbe kele zechuchit tenan: kele etz uchele or uchele etzem uchele zechuchit, peshutehen tehorin umekabbelehen temein. nishberu — taharu. chazar veasa mehen kelim — mekabbelin tumea mikkan ulehabba. mikkan ulehabba in, lemafrea — la!
Tumeat kele zechuchit derabbanan, vetumea yeshana derabbanan. betumea deorayyta — achitu ba rabbanan tumea, betumea derabbanan — la achitu la rabbanan tumea.
Peshutehen miha littammu, deha peshute kele mattachot deorayyta ninhu? avdi behu rabbanan hekkera ki hechi dela lisrof alayyhu teruma vekodashim.
b: Rav ashe amar: leolam lichle cheres damu, udeka kashya lach la littammu miggabban? — hoil venire tocho kevaro.

Shimon ben shatach tikken ketuva laishsha vegazar tumea al kele mattachot. kele mattachot deorayyta ninhu! dichtiv: "ach et hazzahav veet hakkasef vegomer". lo nitzrecha ella letumea yeshana, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beshel tziyyon hammalka sheashta mishte livnah venitmeu kol keleha, veshibberatan unetanatan letzoref verittechan veasa mehen kelim chadashim. veamru chachamim: yachzeru letumeatan yeshana.
May tama? mishshum geder me chattat nagu bah.
Hanicha leman deamar lo lechol hattumeot amru, ella letumeat hammet bilvad amru — shappir.
Ella leman deamar lechol hattumeot amru, may ikka lememar? amar abbaye: gezera shemma lo yikkovennu bichde tohorato.
Rava amar: gezera shemma yomru tevila bat yoma ola lah. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deratzfinhu mirtzaf.

Veiddach may hi? ditnan: hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor lekabbel bahen me geshamim — echad kelim gedolim veechad kelim ketannim, vaafillu kele avanim uchele adama uchele gelalim — poslin et hammikve. echad hammanniach veechad hashshocheach, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel metaharin bashshocheach. amar rabbi meir: nimnu verabbu bet shammay al bet hillel. umodim bet shammay bashshocheach bechatzer, shehu tahor. amar rabbi yose: adayin machaloket bimkomah omedet.

Amar rav mesharsheya: deve rav amri: hakkol modim keshehinnicham bishat kishshur avim, temeim. bishat pizzur avim — divre hakkol tehorin. lo nechleku ella shehinnicham bishat kishshur avim, venitpazzeru, vechazru venitkashsheru. mar savar batla machshavto, umar savar lo batla machshavto.
Ulerabbi yose deamar machaloket adayin bimkomah omedet, batzri lehu! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af benot kutim niddot mearisatan — bo bayyom gazru.
Veiddach may hi? ditnan: kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattumea beovi hammardea. amar rabbi tarfon:

a: Akappeach et banay shezzo halacha mekuppachat, sheshshama hashshomea, vetaa: haikkar over umardeo al ketefo veihel tziddo echad al hakkever — timmeu oto, mishshum kelim hammaahilim al hammet.

Amar rabbi akiva, ani atakken sheyyehu divre chachamim kayyaymim: sheyyehu kol hammittaltelim meviin et hattumea al haadam shennose otan beovi hammardea, veal atzman bechol shehen. veal shear adam vechelim — befoteach tefach.
Veamar rabbi yannay: umardea sheamru, en beovyo tefach veyesh behekkefo tefach — vegazru al hekkefo mishshum ovyo.
Ulerabbi tarfon deamar akappeach et banay shehalacha zo mekuppachat — batzru lehu! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af benot kutim niddot mearisatan, bo bayyom gazru. uveiddach sevira leh kerabbi meir.
Veiddach — habbotzer laggat, shammay omer: hucheshar, hillel omer: lo hucheshar. amar lo hillel leshammay: mippene ma botzrin betohora veen moskin betohora?

Amar lo: im takniteni, gozrani tumea af al hammesika. naatzu cherev bevet hammidrash, amru: hannichnas — yikkanes, vehayyotze — al yetze. veoto hayyom haya hillel kafuf veyoshev lifne shammay keechad min hattalmidim. vehaya kashe leyisrael kayyom shennaasa bo haegel. ugezur shammay vehillel vela kabbilu minnayyhu, vaato talmidayyhu gezur vekabbilu minnayyhu.
May tama? amar rabbi zeeri amar rabbi chanina: gezera shemma yivtzerennu bekuppot temeot.

Hanicha leman deamar keli tame choshev mashkin — shappir, ella leman deamar en keli tame choshev mashkin — may ikka lememar? ella amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: gezera shemma yivtzerennu bekuppot mezuppafot.

Rava amar: gezera mishshum hannoshchot. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: peamim sheadam holech lecharmo leda im higgiu anavim livtzira o lo, venotel eshkol anavim lesochoto, umezallef al gabbe anavim — uvishat betzira adayin mashke tofeach alehem.
Veiddach, amar
b: Tavi rishba amar shemuel: af giddule teruma teruma, bo bayyom gazru. may tama? amar rabbi chanina: gezera mishshum teruma tehora beyad yisrael.

Amar rava: i dachashidi lehachi, afroshe name la layfreshu! (ella amar rava: yisrael) kevan deefshar lemebad chitta achat kedishmuel vela kaaved, hemone mehemne. ella gezera mishshum teruma temea beyad kohen, dilma mashhe la gabbeh veate lide takkala.
Veiddach, amar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: af mi shehecheshich lo badderech noten kiso legoy — bo bayyom gazru.

Veiddach, amar bali amar avimi sinvevtaa: pittan veshamnan veyenan uvenotehen — kullan mishshemona asar davar hen. hanicha lerabbi meir, ella lerabbi yose shivsere havyayn! ikka ha derav acha bar adda. deamar rav acha bar adda amar rabbi yitzchak: gazru al pittan mishshum shamnan, veal shamnan mishshum yenan.

Al pittan mishshum shamnan?! may ulemeh deshemen mippat? ella gazru al pittan veshamnan mishshum yenan, veal yenan mishshum benotehen, veal benotehen mishshum davar acher, veal davar acher mishshum davar acher. may davar acher? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: gazru al tinok goy shemtamme beziva, shello yehe tinok yisrael ragil etzlo bemishkav zachur. i hachi, lerabbi meir name teshasre havyayn! ochalin vechelim shennitmeu bemashkin bachada chashev lehu.

Mishna bet shammay omrim: en shorin deyo vesammanim vecharshinin ella kede sheyyishshoru mibbeod yom, uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim: en notnin unnin shel pishtan letoch hattannur ella kede sheyyahbilu mibbeod yom, velo et hatztzemer layyora ella kede sheyyiklot haayin, uvet hillel mattirin.

Bet shammay omrim: en porsin metzudot chayya veofot vedagim ella kede sheyyitztzodu mibbeod yom, uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim: en mochrin legoy veen toanin immo veen magbihin alav ella kede sheyyaggia lemakom karov, uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim: en notnin orot leabbedan, velo kelim lechoves goy ella kede sheyyeasu mibbeod yom. uvechullan bet hillel mattirin im

a: Hashshemesh. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: nohagin hayu bet abba shehayu notnin kele lavan lechoves goy shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat. veshavin ellu veellu, shettoanin korat bet habbad veiggule haggat.

Gemara man tena netinat mayim lidyo zo hi sheriyyaytan? amar rav yosef: rabbi hi. detanya: echad noten et hakkemach veechad noten et hammayim — haacharon chayyayv, divre rabbi. rabbi yose omer: eno chayyayv ad sheyyegabbel.

Amar leh abbaye: vedilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose ella bekemach, devar gibbul hu. aval deyo delav bar gibbul hu, ema lichayyayv! la salka datach, detanya: echad noten et haefer veechad noten et hammayim — haacharon chayyayv, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyegabbel.
Vedilma may "efer" — afar devar gibbul hu?! vehatanya "efer", vehatanya "afar"! midde gabbe hadade tanya?

Tanu rabbanan: potkin mayim lagginna erev shabbat im chashecha umitmallet veholechet kol hayyom kullo, umannichin mugemar tachat hakkelim erev shabbat umitgammerin veholchin kol hayyom kullo, umannichin gofrit tachat hakkelim erev shabbat im chashecha umitgapperin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah, umannichin kilor al gabbe haayin veispelanit al gabbe makka erev shabbat im chashecha umitrappet veholechet kol hayyom kullo. aval en notnin chittin letoch harechayim shel mayim ella bichde sheyyittachanu mibbeod yom.

May tama? amar rabba: mippene shemmashmaat kol. amar leh rav yosef: velema mar mishshum shevitat kelim! detanya: "uvechol asher amarti alechem tishshameru" — lerabbot shevitat kelim. ella amar rav yosef: mishshum shevitat kelim.

Vehasheta deamrat levet hillel it lehu shevitat kelim deorayyta, gofrit umugemar may tama sharu? mishshum dela kaaved maase. unnin shel pishtan may tama sharu — mishshum dela aved maase, umenach nayycha. metzudat chayya veof vedagim deka aved maase, may tama sharu? hatam name belechi vekukere dela kaaved maase.

Vehasheta deamar rav oshaya amar rav assi: man tena shevitat kelim deorayyta — bet shammay hi vela bet hillel, levet shammay ben kaaved maase ben dela kaaved maase — asur. levet hillel af al gav dekaaved maase — shere. vehasheta deamrat dilvet shammay af al gav dela aved maase — asur, i hachi,
b: Mugemar vegofrit may tama sharu bet shammay? hatam mannach aara. gigit vener ukedera veshappud may tama sharu bet shammay? demafkar lehu afkore.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: lo temalle ishsha kedera asasiyyot veturemsin vetanniach letoch hattannur erev shabbat im chashecha, veim netanan — lemotzae shabbat asurin bichde sheyyeasu. kayyotze bo: lo yemalle nachtom chavit shel mayim veyanniach letoch hattannur erev shabbat im chashecha, veim asa ken — lemotzae shabbat asurin bichde sheyyeasu. lema bet shammay hi vela bet hillel? afillu tema bet hillel, gezera shemma yechatte baggechalim.

I hachi mugemar vegofrit name ligzor! hatam la mechatte lehu, dei mechatte salek behu kutera, vekashe lehu. unnin shel pishtan name ligzor! hatam, kevan dekashe lehu zika, la megallu leh: tzemer layyora ligzor! amar shemuel: beyora akura. venechush shemma megis bah! baakura vetucha.

Vehasheta deamar mar gezera shemma yechatte baggechalim, hay kedera chayyeyta shere leannucha erev shabbat im chashecha betannura. may tama? — kevan dela chaze leureta, assoche massach dateh minneh vela ate lechattoye gechalim. uveshil — shappir dame. beshil vela beshil — asir. vei sheda beh garma chayyay — shappir dame.

Vehasheta deamar mar kol midde dekashe leh zika la megallu leh, hay bisra degadya usherik — shappir dame. devarcha vela sherik — asir. degadya vela sherik, devarcha usherik — rav ashe share verav yirmeya middifti asar. ulerav ashe deshare, vehatanya en tzolin basar batzal uvetza ella kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom! hatam devarcha vela sherik.

Ikka deamri: degadya ben sherik ben la sherik — shappir dame. devarcha name usherik — shappir dame. ki peligi devarcha vela sherik — derav ashe share verav yirmeya middifti asar. ulerav ashe deshare, vehatanya en tzolin basar batzal uvetza ella kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom! hatam bevisra aggumere. amar ravina: hay kara chayyay — shappir dame, kevan dekashe leh zika kevisra degadya dame.

Bet shammay omrim en mochrin. tanu rabbanan, bet shammay omrim: lo yimkor adam cheftzo legoy, velo yashilennu, velo yalvennu, velo yitten lo bemattana ella kede sheyyaggia leveto. uvet hillel omrim: kede sheyyaggia labbayit hassamuch lachoma. rabbi akiva omer: kede sheyyetze mippetach beto. amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: hen hen divre rabbi akiva, hen hen divre bet hillel — lo ba rabbi akiva ella lefaresh divre bet hillel.

Tanu rabbanan, bet shammay omrim: lo yimkor adam chametzo legoy ella im ken yodea bo sheyyichle kodem happesach, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: kol zeman shemmuttar leochlo — muttar lemochro. rabbi yehuda omer:
